description: List contacts (customers and suppliers) in Billy. Supports free-text search and filtering. Use this to find a contact ID before creating invoices or bills.

isArchived.description: When true, returns only archived records; when false, only active ones

q.description: Free-text search on name, contactNo, phone, email

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

name: list_contacts
